title: Q1 cell definition
description: One system x configuration x set of the Q1 scoreboard: one ingest realization per conversation, one retrieval per question per policy, and the arms derived from them. Each arm writes one scoreboard cell (cells/<cell_id>/ with receipt.json, run-config.json, rows, answers and judgments). Generated into q1-cells.json by eval/runner/q1/cells/definitions.ts, which also validates every definition (definitionProblems). A campaign manifest references a cell by `id` and a scoreboard cell by an arm's `cell_id`.

set.description: The preregistered set the cell selects questions from (S3-smoke and S2b-ingest: the paid dev smokes).

block.description: The spend block (ledger run) the cell is charged to.

split.description: Conversations from the benchmark's split file; sealed and all need custody (GBRAIN_EVALS_CUSTODY_LOG and an output directory outside the repository).

exclusions.description: Preregistered exclusions: they run and are reported apart, never in a confirmatory cohort.

configuration.description: full-surface: gbrain-defaults on a stack started with GBRAIN_FULL_SURFACE=1, for the labeled think row; every other gbrain row reads a starter-only stack.

runner.description: shim: a protocol v1 system at --system-url (one VM per conversation shard on S1); in-process: a harness control or answering system.

ingest_replicate.description: 2 for the disclosed second LoCoMo ingest.

canonical_instrument.description: The benchmark's instrument id in eval/runner/memory-qa/instruments.ts; its judgments are judge_replicate 0.

probes.description: Write-start-to-queryable probes: the last session plus `sample` sessions per conversation.

only_conversations.description: Dev smoke cells: only these conversations of the dev split run; the rest are never loaded.

ingest_sessions.description: Ingest probes: write only the first N sessions of each conversation.

launch.description: Shim cells: the environment and bootstrap.sh --config the stack starts with.

snapshot_command.description: Shim cells: bootstrap.sh snapshot into $SHOOTOUT_SNAPSHOT_DIR once ingest is complete; the launcher records the realization over its bytes.

restore_command.description: Shim cells: bootstrap.sh restore from $SHOOTOUT_RESTORE_DIR before a resumed cell's command.

estimate.description: Planned dollars from budget-ledger.ts prices and the manifest's stated assumptions.

cell_id.description: The scoreboard cell id: <cell id>.<arm id>.

mode.description: packed: the system's items packed into `budget` tokens, one frozen byte string per question for every reader; native-default: the system's own default amount; own-answer: the system's answer route; agent: an answering system's loop; full-context: the whole history where it fits each reader's window; retrieval-only: rows without readers.
